title: 《吞噬星空2起源大陆》，已经在起点正式上传！
content_zh:
新书，讲述的是罗峰带着界兽摩罗撒，闯过轮回通道，来到起源大陆之后的故事。

主角依然是罗峰。

大家点击我的作者名‘我吃西红柿’，就能找到新书。

又或者在起点站内搜索‘吞噬星空2起源大陆’，也能找到新书。

《吞噬星空》《吞噬星空2起源大陆》，已经在起点正式上传！ 正在手打中，请稍等片刻，

内容更新后，请重新刷新页面，即可获取最新更新！
content_en:
The new book tells the story of Luo Feng taking the world beast Morosa through the passage of reincarnation and arriving at the Origin Continent.

The protagonist is still Luo Feng.

You can find new books by clicking on my author name ‘I Eat Tomatoes’.

Or you can also find new books by searching for ‘Swallowing Starry Sky 2 Origin Continent’ in the starting station.

"Swallowing Starry Sky" and "Swallowing Starry Sky 2 Origin Continent" have been officially uploaded at Qidian!Currently being typed, please wait a moment.

After the content is updated, please refresh the page to get the latest updates!
title_en: "Swallowing Starry Sky 2 Origin Continent" has been officially uploaded at Qidian!
